verdict.rationale: Financial Connections documents linking a user's bank account so it can be debited through Stripe's ACH Direct Debit, including an instant-only verification mode, so a payment can be pulled from a connected account. However, the payment itself runs through a separate Stripe payment method rather than a dedicated pay-by-bank or payment-initiation product. Live geographies are not stated in the docs; only community comments say it is US-only. Missing for 10: a first-party payment-initiation/pay-by-bank API within the product, documented live geographies, hands-on corroboration of the payment flow.
